summary: Staff-Property Linking Automation - All features verified. When assigning co-host/housekeeper to property from Properties page, staff's assigned_properties automatically updated AND tasks auto-generated for existing bookings.
passed_tests: BACKEND: Creating co-host without properties, then assigning via property update auto-adds property to staff's assigned_properties
BACKEND: Creating housekeeper without properties, then assigning via property update auto-adds property to staff's assigned_properties
BACKEND: Creating property with both co-host and housekeeper assigned auto-links both staff members
BACKEND: Tasks auto-generated for existing bookings when staff assigned to property
BACKEND: Co-host gets check_in and check_out tasks auto-generated
BACKEND: Housekeeper gets cleaning task auto-generated
BACKEND: Staff API returns assigned_properties field for Team page display
FRONTEND: Properties page shows 'Assigned Co-Host' dropdown in property form
FRONTEND: Properties page shows 'Assigned Housekeeper' dropdown in property form
FRONTEND: Team page has 'Properties' column showing assigned properties for each staff member
FRONTEND: Team page displays property names as badges/text for each team member
FRONTEND: Operations page shows auto-generated tasks with 'Auto' badge
FRONTEND: Operations page filter cards show correct counts (1 Cleaning, 3 Check-ins, 3 Check-outs)

auto_task_generation_on_property_assignm.details: When staff assigned to property with existing bookings, tasks auto-generated (cleaning for housekeeper, check_in/check_out for co-host)

housekeepers_endpoint.details: GET /api/staff/housekeepers endpoint returns list of active housekeepers for dropdown

team_page_assigned_properties_display.details: Team page has Properties column showing assigned properties for each team member

operations_page_auto_tasks_visible.details: Auto-generated tasks appear on Operations page with Auto badge, showing in appropriate date tabs
